## Claim

The UN General Assembly's adoption of Resolution ES-11/1 by an overwhelming
majority demonstrated broad international condemnation of Russia's invasion
of Ukraine.

## Warrant

A lopsided vote tally (support far outweighing opposition and abstention)
is evidence of near-unanimous international consensus.
